This PKGBUILD is safe to run under `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.

There is no `pkgver()` function, no command substitutions, no `eval`, no `curl`/`wget` calls, and no obfuscated code. Nothing executes that could perform malicious behavior at source-time.

**Source array analysis**: All sources point to the project's own upstream GitHub repository (`https://github.com/just-every/code/releases/download/...` and `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/just-every/code/...`). These are legitimate downloads of the project's own LICENSE, README, and prebuilt binary artifacts. 

**Checksums**: All `sha256sums` are properly populated with actual hashes (not `SKIP`) for all four sources (LICENSE, README, x86_64 binary, aarch64 binary), including the prebuilt binary downloads.

**Out of scope**: The `package()` function (which simply runs `install` commands to copy files into `$pkgdir`) is not executed by `--nobuild`/`--noprepare` and is out of scope for this gate.
</details>
